Hi Elena —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — great conversation. As promised, here’s a concise post-call recap focused on security intake so your security team can start the vendor assessment:

Summary from our call:
- Deployment: you indicated MedSecure will run Redwood in a VPC/private deployment for PHI processing (HIPAA scope).
- Primary concerns: SOC 2 Type II status, data residency (US-only), KMS/HSM integration, and audit/log retention windows.
- Intake preference: you said the security team prefers SIG Lite if feasible, otherwise full CAIQ.

Asks / next steps we suggest (quick wins first):
1) Confirm preferred questionnaire: SIG Lite or CAIQ (we can prefill either). If you need custom fields for HIPAA specifics, flag now.
2) Please share target submission deadline — we suggested EOD next Thursday (2026-02-26) in the call.
3) Evidence starter pack: SOC 2 summary (we can provide a redacted report), network diagram, encryption at-rest/in-transit notes, and the person-of-contact for audit questions.
4) Schedule a 30-minute security intake call with your InfoSec owner + our security lead to walk the prefills and evidence map.

Attachments I’ll include in the next message: short SOC2 one-pager and an internal network diagram sample.

If you prefer, we can kick off with the SIG Lite prefill and only escalate to CAIQ if your procurement requires it.

Open questions for you to confirm:
- SOC 2: do you need the full Type II report or is a redacted summary sufficient for now?
- Residency: any specific sub-regions / FedRAMP constraints we should know about?
- HIPAA: any particular BAAs language you need included early in procurement?

Thanks — I’ll hold on attachments until you confirm the questionnaire path.

Best,

3) Evidence: For intake, a redacted SOC 2 Type II summary is sufficient (no full report at first). Please include year-end date and auditor name. Network diagram and KMS doc are required. Also include a short statement on key rotation cadence and HSM usage if applicable.

4) BAA: We will need a draft BAA during procurement but not immediately — we just need assurance you support BAAs and have a standard template.

Security owner: adding our team mailbox; primary owner is Michael Chen (michael.chen@medsecure.com) — please include him on the intake call.
